title: Execute WP6 BibTeX and Zotero protocol acceptance
description: Follow team/PLAN.md, team/PROTOCOL.md, DELEGATION.md Common rules and applicable child plan; preserve current dirty work. This board records unfinished acceptance/repair, not permission to rebuild existing features. Inspect current implementation and earlier evidence first; fix only reproduced gaps in owned files, record exact commands/results and fail-first controls, and report CLAIMED. No installs, new packages, commits, pushes, publication, real-library access or destructive cleanup. Before expensive checks, acquire exclusive registered path node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/team-serial-check-slot via team.py files add; if another live task owns it, do independent work or hand off rather than overlap runs. Retain full logs and use pinned Node/offline serial Rust/production-preview Playwright. Independent review is required. Existing BibTeX routing, three-way merge and Rust command are present. Run research units/tsc, offline zotero Rust tests and actual production-preview zotero/research tests. Audit C3 pagination/version/server handling, offline/disconnect behavior, local/manual preservation and reviewed field updates; use synthetic mocks only. Test loopback GET-only/no-redirect/size/time limits and metadata across saves. Keep unresolved differences from C3 explicit; no real Zotero access. Report Rust registration changes to integration task. Write the task report to docs/agent-work/2026-10-24-team-reconciliation/wp6.md.

handoff.text:
REJECT (agent-93f6, non-author). Fresh runs all green, logs under node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/team-t009-review/: units.log (vitest src/research 184/184), tsc.log 0, build.log 0, cargo.log (7/7 zotero, offline serial), browser.log (11/11 zotero+research, production preview 1463). TeX fix is correct and its fail-first holds: failfirst-probe.log shows esbuild bundles of git HEAD and of a doctored copy of the current file (only the 3 SYMBOLS entries removed) both give "The book" and exit 1; the current file gives "The TeXbook" and exits 0. Hashes before and after match (hashes-before.txt, hashes-after.txt). Only bibtexImport.ts/.test.ts and wp6.md changed in T009's window. sourceMerge.* are modified, but outside T009 and not reviewed. The reject is for overclaimed verification and a C3 defect:
1) src-tauri/src/zotero.rs test agent_disables_redirects is a tautology: assert_eq!(format!("{:?}",agent), format!("{:?}",agent)) on a locally built agent. No Rust or TS test exercises redirect, the 5 MiB cap or the 12 s timeout. wp6.md/done note say "no-redirect/5MiB/12s bounds verified in Rust inline tests" and "browser-side limit units": both false. Fix: test them for real (for example, factor the agent builder into a fn used by execute_zotero_read and assert on its config, or a loopback mock test), or state plainly that they are enforced (.redirects(0), .timeout(TIMEOUT), .take(MAX_BYTES)) but untested. Also note that .take silently truncates and the result then fails as "Invalid JSON".
2) src/research/zotero.ts browser fetch path has no redirect:"error", no timeout and no size cap (ZOTERO_TIMEOUT_MS/ZOTERO_MAX_BYTES are unused). wp6.md calls this path an "approved deviation", but no approval exists: roadmap PLAN.md:137 approves only the in-house BibTeX parser, and C3 specifies the native command. Either add the limits plus mock-fetch unit tests, or list it as an unresolved C3 difference.
3) Defect in previewZoteroChanges (zotero.ts): receivedItems[index] is assumed to line up with result.sources[index], but parseCslJson skips untitled or non-object items. With items [{id:KEY_UNTITLED,no title},{id:KEY_REAL,title}], the stored zoteroOrigin.itemKey for "Real Book" is KEY_UNTITLED (zotero-index-probe.mjs/.log, exit 1). Proof command: node node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/team-t009-review/zotero-index-probe.mjs <esbuild bundle of src/research/zotero.ts>. Add a unit regression that fails first.
4) The report does not state the C3 differences, although the task requires it: the ResearchPanel refresh fetches one page of users/0/items and ignores nextStart (C3 stop rule: silent truncation); there is no polling, no since/version stored, no server-change handling and no remote-deletion "unavailable" marking; pollZoteroUpdates is unused. Also texToText still silently drops every other unknown macro ({\METAFONT}book -> "The book", \XeTeX -> "", no warning; unknown-macro-probe.log), while C3 says unsupported macros remain warned/raw. Either fix or list them.
5) The record has gaps: there is no cargo.log in team-t009/ (the "7/7" claim had no log), tsc2/tsc3.log are 0 bytes, and "metadata persists through reload" cites research.spec, which tests Ibid. persistence, not zoteroOrigin.
6) Minor, in an owned file: the ResearchPanel zotero-status span hardcodes color #666 (live light/dark rule).
What is acceptable as-is: browser tests use page.route mocks only; no listener on 23119 during my run; loopback/GET/credential/traversal URL guards are tested; refresh is off by default; disconnect keeps local sources; no deletions; metadata additive. To close: fix or honestly document 1-5 in wp6.md, then npx vitest run src/research and cargo test --locked --offline --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --jobs 1 zotero -- --test-threads=1 with retained logs.
